== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Life Well is a rare and highly valuable liquid produced as an unintended byproduct of industrial work within a specific habitat. Housed in an [[Iron|iron-gray]] building comparable to a large barn, the facility contains a vessel that resembles a laundry tub and emits a bright emerald glow. The substance itself is described as having a flavor similar to weak tea. Its primary function is to strengthen an individual's internal [[Life aura|life aura]], which can result in the restoration of youth or the healing of injuries. While it is capable of significantly increasing a person's life force and potentially advancing their power, the liquid is extremely scarce; workers might only receive a small amount following a successful project. Although generally beneficial, the water can be dangerous for older users, occasionally resulting in death or a coma.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Located near the [[Blackflame Empire]] delegation, the Life Well is a specialized facility capable of bolstering a line of [[Life aura|life aura]] and restoring youth. During his time at the site, [[Lindon]] sat against the structure. While there, [[Orthos]] drank from the well, and [[Dross]] managed to secure a single vial from the source.}}
